overall_goal: Boil, drain, and rinse the pasta

goals.description: Prepare the pot with salted water and set it on the stove to boil
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a pot, fills it with water, places it on the stove, turns on the heat, and adds salt to prepare for boiling.

goals.description: Measure the desired amount of pasta
goals.rationale: The person grabs the bag of pasta, pours it into measuring cups, weighs it on a scale, and sets the measured pasta aside.

goals.description: Add the pasta to the boiling water and stir it periodically
goals.rationale: The person checks the water, pours the pasta in once it boils, and repeatedly stirs the pasta to ensure even cooking.

goals.description: Taste and check the pasta to ensure it is fully cooked
goals.rationale: The person scoops out a piece of pasta, cools it down, and touches it to verify if it has finished cooking.

goals.description: Drain the cooked pasta and rinse it with cold water
goals.rationale: The person pours the pot's contents into a colander in the sink and runs cold water over the pasta to stop the cooking process.
